sermon.title: Bowing and Kneeling
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from Psalm 95:6 to bow and kneel before the Lord. Isaiah declares there is no other God, that all may look to him and be saved, and that every knee will bow. Each will give account; Jesus changes sinners. He walks through Jesus’ names—Emmanuel, Wonderful, Mighty God, Lord, Word of God—and tells of hardened prisoners in Mexico kneeling at the gospel.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Acts 16:31 spoken as “acts 11 17”; Mark 1:1 spoken as “Matthew or mark 11”; Revelation 19:16 spoken as “19 6”; founders’ religious freedom limited to Christian denominations; Jesus “really means Joshua”; government as the third-largest Bible topic; Trinity compared to father/son/husband. Sensitive content kept as spoken: no other religion; Democrats and liberals pushing Muslims, who “do not have the right to freedom in America”; men vs. women emotions; denial of water baptism “ridiculous hypocritical doctrine”; homosexual acts, pedophiles and abominations list; woman held in a Mexican prison as a reward for convicts.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, And into His courts with praise. Be thankful to Him, and bless His name.

faqs.question: Does Psalm 95:6 need interpretation?
faqs.answer: No, it says what it says: bow and kneel.

faqs.question: Why didn’t Adam and Eve die the day they ate?
faqs.answer: He says God killed the first lamb instead.

faqs.question: Is God there to step on you when you fail?
faqs.answer: No, he is there to save you.

faqs.question: Does God’s love have a condition for salvation?
faqs.answer: Yes, you must hear, believe and call on Jesus.

faqs.question: Is baptism just an outward symbol?
faqs.answer: He says it is an inward work.

faqs.question: What does the name Jesus correspond to?
Should the church talk about government?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is a major Bible topic.

faqs.question: Do the wicked bow to us?
faqs.answer: No, to the gospel and to Jesus.
